WATCH.rival: reputational cue vs actual internal concern, donation metric vs antisocial behavior

IGNORANCE.rival: latent altruism vs impression-management/strategic ignorance/avoidance of moral choice

NORM.rival: enforcement deters vs pricing changes social norm

CULTURE.rival: fixed universal preference vs culture-specific behavior and replicability limits

BIO.rival: reciprocal conditional exchange vs intrinsic partner preservation

AI.rival: situationally conditioned instrument behaviors vs endogenous enduring motive

ethics: Do not disclose private parties, do not propose coercive or harmful tests, no consciousness inference from output
notes: These are 14 distinct identifier-based publications/preprints but not 14 independent replications or newly discovered works.
Some works already in C01–C10 are deliberately reconnected to later studies; no double-count.
Watch-eye antisocial-behavior meta-analysis is an additional conceptual context reference in the companion narrative, not a counted record here.
